capabilities: bounded objective ActionPlan and ordered ActionStep models
synchronous plan validation, execution, observation, verification, and continuation
per-step authoritative permission classification and one-time confirmation
structured Windows UI Automation, browser, and native vision observations
backend-computed VERIFIED, FAILED, and UNKNOWN verification
bounded retry, re-observation, explicit alternate-target recovery, timeout, and cancellation
assistant plan proposal adapter whose output remains data only
SQLite plan state, observation metadata, and append-only redacted audit trail
password, credential-dialog, secure-desktop, and system-critical context protection
known_gaps: Windows UI Automation, browser DOM, and native vision producers are intentionally not implemented in this stream.
No Tauri plan UI was implemented; callers use the REST control surface.
Verification is deterministic expected-state subset matching; richer adapter-specific predicates can be added behind the same backend boundary.
